text:
ria: starting staged rollout for planner-service v2.0.5-hotfix. plan: 3% -> 15% over 25m. change window 23:30-01:30 UTC. target region: us-east-2. rollout id rl-2026-03-21-06

deploy-bot: rollout rl-2026-03-21-06 started: routing 3% traffic to v2.0.5-hotfix /planner/*

charlie: smoke harness running. watching p95/p99 and 5xx.

maria: seeing increased backpressure traces on queue-worker in us-east-2b; p99 +180ms and a small rise in 429s on that shard.

ria: hold expansion at 3% while we triage. charlie/maria, can you paste logs and queue metrics?

maria: log excerpt from us-east-2b-02:
```
WARN queue: processing delay=850ms shard=us-east-2b worker=queue-7
METRIC inflight_jobs 5 -> 42 (1m)
ERR http: 429 downstream capacity limit reached
```

ops-runbook-bot: recommended quick actions: 1) pause rollout 2) apply per-shard pin back to v2.0.4 for us-east-2b 3) create infra ticket and capture worker profiles. templates: pause: `deployctl rollout pause --id rl-2026-03-21-06 --reason "hold: queue backpressure us-east-2b"` pin: `routingctl pin --service planner --to-version v2.0.4 --shard us-east-2b` rollback: `deployctl rollback --id rl-2026-03-21-06 --to-version v2.0.4 --confirm`

deploy-bot: pause request received from ria. executing pause...

deploy-bot: rollout rl-2026-03-21-06 paused at 3% (user: ria). state=PAUSED. note="hold: queue backpressure us-east-2b"

charlie: collecting worker profiles now and creating INFR-2600. tagging infra-oncall.

ria: quick vote: pin us-east-2b to v2.0.4 and keep rollout paused globally? react with :thumbsup: to pin+hold, :thumbsdown: to keep investigating.

maria: :thumbsup:

charlie: :thumbsup:

ria: pin approved. applying routing pin.

deploy-bot: routingctl: pin applied -> service=planner shard=us-east-2b -> version v2.0.4. routing change id rc-12009.

deploy-bot: note: rollout remains PAUSED and will not auto-increment until manual resume.

ria: changelog updated: "paused planner-service v2.0.5-hotfix canary due to queue backpressure in us-east-2b; pinned affected shard to v2.0.4 while infra triages (INFR-2600)."

ops-runbook-bot: rollback snippet if needed: `deployctl rollback --id rl-2026-03-21-06 --to-version v2.0.4 --force --confirm`

infra-oncall (bot): INFR-2600 acknowledged. initial triage indicates worker concurrency change in v2.0.5 caused hot spots under medium fanout. ETA 30m for mitigation plan.

ria: status=PAUSED_PINNED owner=ria. infra, QA, and release owner will coordinate here for the next steps. will resume after infra confirms fix and we re-run targeted smoke and gold prompts.
